Nehemiah 2:18 KJV
Then I told them of the hand of my God which was good upon me…

?

✔in that shop or office you consider small, you will testify..
✔In your marriage, you will testify..

?
The hand of God upon you will make the huge difference anywhere you go today in Jesus name.
